title: &aThe Vaults
subtitle: Two kinds of storage, one ladder. Each rung needs the other. Then OmniVault keeps climbing.

quests.title: Everything You Own, Carried
quests.subtitle: A sack, grown up.
description: A &6Backpack&r starts as a Supplementaries &6Sack&r: sew it into leather and string with two &6Ashen Alloy&r. Carry it, wear it or set it down; it keeps everything inside either way.
&7When you die, your items wait in your corpse. A backpack is one item. Think about that.

quests.title: Chests That Grow
quests.subtitle: The larder outgrew the larder.
description: A &6Sophisticated Chest&r is planks around a lever. Ring it with &6Ashen Alloy&r for an &6Iron Chest&r, or put a &6Tier Upgrade&r on a placed chest to grow it where it stands. Barrels work the same way.
In this pack the storage tiers follow the Ember Forge: &fcopper&r is Create copper sheets, &firon&r is Ashen Alloy, &6gold&r Duskforged, &bdiamond&r Moonsilver, &8netherite&r Deepsteel.

quests.title: A Drawer for Everything
quests.subtitle: Built on a Sophisticated barrel.
description: An OmniVault &6Drawer&r holds a great many of one item and shows it on its face. Its frame is a &6Sophisticated Barrel&r, planks and iron nuggets: the two vaults start sharing parts here and never stop.

quests.title: Upgrades
quests.subtitle: A bag that bends over so you don't have to.
description: Every upgrade starts as an &6Upgrade Base&r: Ashen Alloy, leather and string. A &6Pickup Upgrade&r scoops loot into the pack as you walk; set its filter so it leaves the rotten flesh where it fell.
Magnet, smelting, compacting, void, feeding, tool swapper: JEI has every recipe.

quests.title: A Table on Your Back
quests.subtitle: Craft where you stand.
description: A &6Crafting Upgrade&r puts a crafting grid in the backpack. Keep one spare: OmniVault's &6Crafting Terminal&r is built around one.

quests.title: Iron-Bound
quests.subtitle: Bigger, and nothing falls out.
description: Ring a backpack with &6Ashen Alloy&r (or Create copper sheets for copper first) and it grows with everything still inside. Each tier holds more and fits more upgrades.

quests.title: &eThe Logic Processor
quests.subtitle: Omnium, Duskforged and redstone.
description: &6Omnium&r is amethyst, quartz and redstone ground to dust, blended with Ashen Alloy and smelted. No quartz before the Nether? Mix amethyst, redstone and a &6Remnant Shard&r in a Create basin instead.
Omnium, &6Duskforged&r and redstone make a &6Logic Processor&r. Both vaults run on it: the Sophisticated &6Controller&r, every &6advanced&r upgrade, every OmniVault device.

quests.title: One Room, Many Chests
quests.subtitle: A Sophisticated controller, thinking in OmniVault.
description: A &6Storage Controller&r joins every Sophisticated chest and barrel touching it into one network. Its brain is now an OmniVault &6Logic Processor&r.

quests.title: The Storage Hub
quests.subtitle: Every chest it touches becomes one.
description: An OmniVault &6Storage Hub&r is built around a Sophisticated &6Controller&r. It joins every chest, barrel, drawer and Sophisticated chest it touches; &6Inventory Cables&r carry it further.

quests.title: &aThe Crafting Terminal
quests.subtitle: Every chest at once, and a table to work at.
description: A &6Terminal&r wired to your Storage Hub shows the whole network in one scrolling view: search by name, &e@mod&r or &e#tag&r. Add a Sophisticated &6Crafting Upgrade&r and redstone and it becomes a &6Crafting Terminal&r.
&o"I've seen Sovereigns' treasuries kept worse."&r

quests.title: Gilded at Dusk
quests.subtitle: Gold tier, Duskforged.
description: The gold tier of every backpack, chest and barrel takes &6Duskforged Ingots&r. So does the gold &6Tier Upgrade&r.

quests.title: Reaching Further
quests.subtitle: A chest across the room, still in the network.
description: A &6Storage Link&r carries a Sophisticated controller's network to chests that don't touch it. OmniVault's wireless terminal is built around one.

quests.title: &bThe Advanced Processor
quests.subtitle: Moonsilver thinks faster.
description: A Logic Processor, &6Moonsilver&r, quartz and Omnium. Crafting processors, pattern terminals, assemblers, wireless and the Nexus Core all need one.

quests.title: Advanced Upgrades
quests.subtitle: Every upgrade, sharper.
description: Every &6advanced&r Sophisticated upgrade takes Duskforged, Moonsilver and an OmniVault &6Logic Processor&r where the redstone used to be. Start with an &6Advanced Pickup Upgrade&r: filters, and it never picks up what you told it not to.

quests.title: Moonsilver Stitching
quests.subtitle: Diamond tier.
description: Diamond-tier backpacks, chests and barrels take &6Moonsilver Ingots&r.

quests.title: &dThe Nexus Core
quests.subtitle: Let the vault do the crafting.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"The Crown's treasurers kept ledgers that wrote themselves. I thought it was sorcery. It was just very good bookkeeping."&r
Advanced Processors, Omnium and an ender eye build a &6Nexus Core&r: the heart of a network with no channel limits, cells, wireless terminals and &6autocrafting&r.

&7Encode a recipe in a &6Pattern Encoding Terminal&7, hand it to a &6Pattern Provider&7, let an &6Assembler&7 and a &6Crafting Processor&7 do the work, and ask the terminal for what you need. JEI's &e+&7 button loads any recipe into the encoder.

quests.title: The Vault in Your Pocket
quests.subtitle: A Storage Link with a screen.
description: A &6Wireless Terminal&r: a Crafting Terminal, an Advanced Processor, Omnium and a Sophisticated &6Storage Link&r. Reach the network from anywhere within a Wireless Transmitter's range.

quests.title: &3The Quantum Processor
quests.subtitle: Echoes, pearls and Deepsteel.
description: An Advanced Processor, &6Deepsteel&r, an echo shard and an ender pearl. The million-item cells, quantum links and the quantum wireless terminal start here.

quests.title: Deepsteel Seams
quests.subtitle: The last tier.
description: The netherite tier of backpacks, chests and barrels takes &6Deepsteel&r (and a netherite upgrade template at the smithing table). The highest stack upgrades take Deepsteel and Sunforged too.

quests.title: &6Without Limit
quests.subtitle: The omega stack upgrade.
description: A Tier 4 stack upgrade and an &5Eclipse Core&r. Every slot holds as much as you will ever own. The &6Everlasting&r and &6Inception&r upgrades want a core as well.

quests.title: &5Everywhere at Once
quests.subtitle: The quantum wireless terminal.
description: Smith a Wireless Terminal with a &6Quantum Upgrade Template&r and an &5Eclipse Core&r: the network from any distance, in any dimension. Singularity cells, quantum bridges and the quantum assembler are built from cores too.

quests.title: Six Vaults
quests.subtitle: Copper to Omnium, one kit at a time.
description: OmniVault keeps its own chests: &6Vaults&r, with a lid on a hinge, a &eSort&r button and a comparator reading of how full they are. A &6Copper Vault&r is Create &6copper sheets&r around a Sophisticated Chest: forty-five slots.

Iron (Ashen Alloy) holds 54, Gold (Duskforged) 81, Diamond (Moonsilver and glass) 108, Netherite (Deepsteel, at the smithing table) 135 and shrugs off explosions; Omnium, built on a Netherite Vault with an Advanced Processor, holds 162.
&7A &6Vault Upgrade&7 kit raises a placed vault one tier and keeps its contents, name and facing; the Copper kit turns a plain chest or barrel into a Copper Vault. Build a Copper Vault.

quests.title: Some Things Should Burn
quests.subtitle: What you can't carry, nobody gets.
description: The Ashen Company's rule on the march: what you can't carry, you burn. &o"Rotten flesh never won a war,"&r says the Captain.

A &6Trash Can&r is Ashen Alloy and cobblestone around a lava bucket. Whatever goes in is gone, though the last thing you threw away can still be pulled back out. Its automation filter decides what hoppers and pipes may void: an allow-list or a deny-list.
&7Build a Trash Can.

quests.title: Nine Nuggets, One Ingot
quests.subtitle: One drawer, three shapes of the same thing.
description: A &6Compacting Drawer&r holds an item, its block and its nuggets as one amount and hands out whichever shape you ask for. Pour in gold nuggets; take out ingots, or blocks.
&7Ashen Alloy, two pistons, a Drawer and a Logic Processor. Build one.

quests.title: Deeper Drawers
quests.subtitle: Iron, gold, diamond, netherite: the Forge's four.
description: A drawer holds thirty-two stacks of one thing (sixteen per slot in a 1×2, eight in a 2×2). Capacity upgrades multiply that and add up: &fIron&r ×2 (Ashen Alloy), &6Gold&r ×4 (Duskforged), &bDiamond&r ×8 (Moonsilver), &8Netherite&r ×16 (Deepsteel). Each is built on the one before, starting from a &6Blank Upgrade Card&r: Ashen Alloy, Omnium, gold nuggets and a Logic Processor.
A &6Void Drawer Upgrade&r destroys whatever no longer fits.
&7Sneak-right-click a drawer with an empty hand for its upgrade screen. Make an Iron Drawer Upgrade.

quests.title: A Wall That Answers
quests.subtitle: Every drawer within twelve blocks, as one.
description: A &6Drawer Controller&r joins every drawer within twelve blocks: touching it, touching each other, or joined by &6Drawer Trim&r. Hoppers, pipes and the vault network see the whole wall through it.
A &6Drawer Key&r (Omnium, Ashen Alloy and a gold nugget) locks a drawer to its item, so an empty slot keeps a ghost of what belongs there. Use the key on the controller and the whole wall locks.
&7Build a controller (Ashen Alloy, Omnium, comparators, a drawer, a Logic Processor), four trim and a key.

quests.title: Tools of the Trade
quests.subtitle: Turn it, take it apart, carry it off.
description: Last Light moves a room at a time. The &6OmniTool&r (Ashen Alloy and Omnium) turns and configures OmniVault blocks with a right-click and dismantles them with a sneak-right-click.
The &6Relocator&r (slime, Ashen Alloy and a Logic Processor) picks up a chest, a furnace or another mod's machine with everything still inside, and sets it down somewhere else. Sixteen uses.
&7Make both.

quests.title: A Hand That Never Tires
quests.subtitle: Deepsteel at the smithing table.
description: Smith a Relocator with a &6netherite upgrade template&r and a &6Deepsteel Ingot&r: the &6Netherite Relocator&r never wears out.
&7The templates still come from the bastions. Make one.

quests.title: The Same Box Everywhere
quests.subtitle: Three colours on a latch, one chest in every world.
description: A &6Linked Vault&r is twenty-seven slots shared by every Linked Vault with the same three colours on its latches, in any world: blaze rods from Morgrath's forts, wool, obsidian, an ender chest and a Logic Processor. Dye the latches to pick a channel; a diamond or the &6OmniTool&r makes it yours alone.
A &6Linked Pouch&r (leather, wool, an ender pearl, a Logic Processor) binds to a vault with a sneak-right-click and opens it from anywhere.
&7Build a Linked Vault and a Linked Pouch.

quests.title: Cells and a Drive
quests.subtitle: Chests are for people.
description: A Nexus network keeps its own stores in &6storage cells&r: a &6Cell Housing&r (glass, redstone, Ashen Alloy) around a &6Storage Matrix&r. The 4K matrix is redstone, Omnium dust, quartz and a Logic Processor.
A &6Cell Drive&r is ten bays built into two Sophisticated &6gold barrels&r, each bay with a light: green with room to spare, amber nearly full, red full. &6Nexus Cable&r joins it to the core.
&7Build a Cell Drive and a 4K Storage Cell, and slot the cell in.

quests.title: Pipes Into the Vault
quests.subtitle: The Works pour; the network sorts.
description: The &6Ashen Works&r never stop: crushers, furnaces, a line of item pipes spilling ingots on the floor. A &6Network Port&r is the whole network as one inventory and one tank. Pipe into it and the network files everything; pipe out of it and the network pays.
The vault needs no power of its own. The Works do.
&7Ashen Alloy, a hopper, a chest, Omnium and a Logic Processor. Build a Network Port and run the Works' pipes into it.

quests.title: &bRoom for Everything
quests.subtitle: Every cell is four of the last.
description: Every matrix is four of the one before. Four 4K matrices, Duskforged and a Logic Processor make a &616K&r; four 16Ks, Moonsilver and an Advanced Processor a &b64K&r. An item cell holds up to 128 kinds of thing.

Fluids go in a &6Fluid Cell Housing&r (a bucket where the hollow was) around the same matrices: a 4K fluid cell holds a thousand buckets of up to 32 fluids. A cell keeps its contents in the world, not on the item, and an empty cell comes apart again when you sneak-use it.
&7Build a 64K Storage Cell and a 4K Fluid Cell.

quests.title: In, Out and Through
quests.subtitle: The network's hands.
description: Buses are Omnium and a Logic Processor around a hopper, a piston or a chest. An &6Import Bus&r pulls items and fluids out of what it faces; an &6Export Bus&r pushes them in; a &6Storage Bus&r makes that inventory part of the network, with a filter, a priority and an access mode.
Old Pell's &6Bag Opener&r empties from the bottom. Put an Import Bus under it and everything the dead carried lands in the vault, sorted.
&7Upgrade cards make devices better: Speed, Stack, Fuzzy, Redstone. Build one of each bus.

quests.title: Hands in the World
quests.subtitle: Mine into the vault, build out of it.
description: A &6Destructor&r mines the block in front of it into the network; a &6Constructor&r places blocks from it. Omnium and a Logic Processor around a diamond pickaxe or a dispenser.
A cobblestone generator with a Destructor on its face never needs you again.
&7Build both.

quests.title: The Vault Talks Back
quests.subtitle: A number on a screen, a signal on a wire.
description: A &6Storage Monitor&r shows one item and its live count; right-click it to store or take. A &6Signal Emitter&r gives a redstone signal while the network holds at least (or fewer than) a number of something you choose. Wire it to a furnace line and the line stops when the shelves are full.
&7Build a Storage Monitor and a Signal Emitter.

quests.title: Recipes Written Once
quests.subtitle: Patterns and the Provider.
description: The Crown's treasurers wrote a recipe down once and never again. A &6Pattern Encoding Terminal&r (a Storage Terminal, an Advanced Processor, a crafting table and a Blank Pattern) writes one onto a &6Blank Pattern&r: a &6crafting pattern&r for a 3×3 recipe, or a &6processing pattern&r (up to nine inputs, three outputs) for a furnace, a Create machine or a Works crusher. JEI's &e+&r fills the editor for you.
A &6Pattern Provider&r holds nine patterns and pushes processing inputs into the machine it faces.
&7Build the encoding terminal, encode a crafting pattern and build a Pattern Provider.

quests.title: &dAsk, and It Is Made
quests.subtitle: Assemblers and Crafting Processors.
description: An &6Assembler&r carries out crafting steps (Omnium, an Advanced Processor, pistons and a crafter); up to four Speed Upgrades double its pace again and again. A &6Crafting Processor&r runs one job at a time (Omnium, Duskforged, an Advanced and a Logic Processor); right-click it for the Crafting Status screen. More of each, more at once.

&7Middle-click a craftable item in any terminal, enter an amount and press &eCalculate&7: the plan lists what it takes from storage, what it crafts and what's missing. &eStart&7 reserves the ingredients. Build an Assembler and a Crafting Processor.

quests.title: Range
quests.subtitle: Thirty-two blocks is not a kingdom.
description: Sneak-use a Wireless Terminal on the Nexus Core to link it; it reaches thirty-two blocks from the core. A &6Wireless Transmitter&r (an ender pearl, a lightning rod, Omnium and an Advanced Processor) reaches sixty-four, and every &6Range Upgrade&r (a Blank Upgrade Card, an ender pearl and amethyst) forty-eight more, up to four.
&7Build a Wireless Transmitter and a Range Upgrade.

quests.title: &5Two Places, One Vault
quests.subtitle: Range ends. Bridges don't.
description: A &6Quantum Bridge&r is four echo shards, two Quantum Processors, two ender chests, a Block of Omnium and an &5Eclipse Core&r. Use a &6Quantum Link Card&r on one bridge, then on the other, and the network runs through the pair across any distance and between worlds while both are loaded: a Nether outpost on your main vault, a camp under the black sun wired to Last Light.
&7Build two bridges and a link card, and entangle them.

quests.title: The Bottomless Cell
quests.subtitle: Four thousand 4K matrices deep.
description: 256K (Omnium and an Advanced Processor), 1M (echo shards and a Quantum Processor), 16M (Deepsteel and an Eclipse Core), and last the &5Singularity&r: four 16M matrices, four Quantum Processors and an Eclipse Core. Two billion items of up to 1,024 kinds, or half a billion buckets.

Every step is four of the last, so a Singularity is four thousand 4K matrices deep, and every 16K among them wants Duskforged. Nobody builds that by hand. Let the Assemblers do it, and keep the Forge fed.
&7Build a Singularity Storage Cell.

quests.title: &6The Vault That Thinks
quests.subtitle: Sixteen crafts a cycle, and a crown's worth of ledgers.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"The Crown kept a vault under the throne with every grain the realm owned, and ledgers that counted themselves. You've built the same thing in a shed. The Crown would be furious."&r
The &6Quantum Assembler&r does sixteen times the crafts per cycle of an Assembler: four Quantum Processors, Omnium, an Assembler and an &5Eclipse Core&r.

Every chest at Last Light, every drawer, every cell, every outpost behind a bridge, answering one terminal in your pocket and building what you ask for while you sleep. The Sovereigns broke the sun to share it. You only had to share a network.
&7Build a Quantum Assembler.
